title: REPORT on the role of cohesion policy investment in resolving the current housing crisis
part_text: by establishing a link with the European Green Deal
part_context: Notes that combining and complementing ERDF-CF, ESF+ and JTF grants with EIB financial instruments can contribute to increasing the leverage effect of investments and access to finance for property developers, builders and final beneficiaries by establishing a link with the European Green Deal; supports the creation of a dedicated housing facility within the structure of the EIB financial instruments; underlines, furthermore, the importance of promoting green procurement that sets environmental and social conditions; stresses that simplification of funds and transparency in the use of funds are essential for the efficient and strategic use of investments, and for a multiplier effect for financial efforts;
